## Competitive Analysis at SEOwind [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/competitive-analysis/\#0-toc-title)

SEOwind collects all the data on competitors and their content in one place.

You get the overview of the top 10 SERPs in one view with all the data you need to create outstanding content.

In the Competitive Analysis section you’ll find:

- top SERPs title and meta description,
- keywords they rank for in the top 30,
- word count – how long the top-ranking content is,
- competitor’s [content outlines](https://seowind.io/content-outline-article-blog/).

![seowind competitive analysis](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/CA1-1024x552.png)

## Why use SEOwind for Competitive Analysis [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/competitive-analysis/\#1-toc-title)

You don’t need to open each SERP in a separate tab and analyze it one by one. And then use other [SEO tools to analyze keywords each SERP](https://seowind.io/serp-analyzer/) is ranking for. Having everything in one place makes drawing conclusions much easier. This way you can notice similarities and discrepancies. This makes the whole process of creating a brief much quicker, especially if you’re creating briefs at scale.
